note: Family campground at 3064 SR 43, Mogadore (Brimfield Township, Portage County), between US-224 and I-76, on 50 wooded and open acres around two small tree-lined lakes, less than a mile from Mogadore Reservoir. A few tent sites in summer. Daily, weekly, monthly and seasonal rates. --Claude
summary: Operator's site is live and confirms the stored fees $45-50 (plus AC $2), 50A/water, 120 sites, pull-throughs, showers, laundry, dump, deposit. Added phone booking. Facebook link in website should go; rig length and season not stated.
flags: WEBSITE: the field holds a Facebook link above the operator's site. Keep only http://cherokeeparkcampground.com/ (live; rates, contact and site map; the footer dates from 2013 but the $45-$50 rates are not old-looking).

GATE: $45 W/E 30A base, $47 with AC at the operator's $2/day; 50A $50 ($52 with AC). The AC charge counts only when running it; the 30A base stays under $50. Rate page has no year (a 2024+ date isn't shown); RV Life 4*/$$. Good Sam Park per stored directory value (true). Gateway: Cuyahoga Valley NP 28 km. GOOGLE MAPS: 4.3 from 121 reviews, listed as 'Cherokee Park Co', phone 330-673-1964 matches. Recent review text didn't load. Not a family stay.

LONG-STAY TEST: posts a daily rate and sells weekly, monthly $500 and 'Season $1950 plus metered electric'. Nightly share isn't published; test 4 can't be measured from the operator's pages. Imagery shows scattered RVs among the trees, not obviously packed.

WATERFRONT LEAD (weak): operator says the grounds are 'wooded and open space surrounding two small tree-lined lakes'. Imagery shows one tree-ringed pond about 100 m south of the pin with the loop road on its east bank. Stored not waterfront stands unless a re-audit finds pads on the bank.
